column3: The Hebrew describes the lot as “coming out”; BSB says the allotment “extended.”
The Hebrew describes movement “from Bethel toward Luz”; BSB identifies Bethel with Luz parenthetically. The Hebrew also uses singular collective “the Archite,” while BSB has plural “Archites.”
The Hebrew uses singular collective “the Japhletite”; BSB has plural “the Japhletites.”
The Hebrew names Manasseh before Ephraim; BSB reverses their order.
The Hebrew explicitly names “the border” twice; BSB leaves it implicit while continuing the description.
The Hebrew explicitly names “the sons of Manasseh”; BSB says “Manasseh.”
The Hebrew uses a singular collective name for the Canaanite and explicitly names “Ephraim”; BSB uses plural “Canaanites” and “Ephraimites.”
